note: Northumberland County, VA zones its land (nine districts, C-1 to H-1, in Chapter 148 with referenced Zoning Maps), but no public ArcGIS REST or other queryable zoning-district layer was found for the county or any town; the county's InteractiveGIS viewer is behind a public-access sign-in and third-party sites list only generic or paid zoning data. The county has no incorporated towns to publish zoning separately.
